summary: This release adds a Validation Summary Report, Clinical Observation Types reference table and brings enhancements to Issue Management, Data Export, and Outgoing Validation. It also adds an Outgoing File Monitoring screen and brings enhancements/fixes across Issue Log, Data Export, Data Reference, and role permissions.

updates.title: Download Validation Summary Report
updates.body: From Data Ingest Files tab we can now download a single excel summary of all validation rules configured for a file.

updates.title: Outgoing File Monitoring
updates.body: New tab in File Monitoring to track every outgoing file (Data Export or Data Report).

updates.title: Issue Management
updates.body: Added search, a date range filter, and cleaned field labels (Severity & Validation Handling). Auto-resolved issues now show "System" as the resolver.

updates.title: Outgoing Validation
updates.body: Added bulk download of files, extract type filter and additional data points in detail view.

updates.title: Grace Period Anchor Field
updates.body: Converted from free text to a dropdown field (Earliest/Latest), defaulting to Latest.

updates.title: Data Export
updates.body: SFTP delivery path is now optional, and lengthy catalog names now show on hover.

updates.title: Data Export
updates.body: SFTP Destination Location field now accepts spaces.

updates.title: Reference Table
updates.body: Added implicit_rules field to Program Brand Milestone Status Rules.

updates.title: Data Export
updates.body: Fixed long configuration names breaking column width and readability.

updates.title: Data Reference
updates.body: Fixed new records jumping position mid-entry, and an inconsistent column header.

updates.title: Role Permissions
updates.body: Fixed restricted actions showing for Admin, Project Manager, and Production Services roles.
